name: HIS Synthetic Benchmark V1.3
description: This deposit contains only synthetic hospital-information-system benchmark tables, canonical references, source-valid tables, frozen corruption conditions, rule files, and integrity manifests used to reproduce the reported internal experiments. It contains no MIMIC-IV data, no real patient records, and no patient-level derivatives of restricted clinical data. The accompanying public software repository contains the frozen cleaning implementation, evaluator, configuration-driven wrappers, aggregate evidence, and MIMIC-compatible code that requires independently authorized data access.
